requirement.statement: 系统 SHALL support named attractor profiles that bundle one or more project-level attractor files for reusable validation contexts.

case.given: A workspace has `codument/attractors/project.md` and `codument/attractors/product.md`.
case.when: No explicit attractor profile configuration exists.
case.then: The effective `default` profile SHALL include `codument/attractors/project.md` and `codument/attractors/product.md`.

case.given: A workspace defines `codument/config/attractor-profiles.json`.
case.when: A plan hook references a profile by name.
case.then: The system SHALL resolve that profile to its configured attractor file list.
case.and: The system SHALL report `BLOCKED` if the referenced profile or any required attractor file is missing.

case.given: A workspace contains custom files under `codument/attractors/`.
case.when: Those files are referenced by an attractor profile.
case.then: The system SHALL treat them as valid attractors without assuming only `project.md` and `product.md` exist.

requirement.statement: 系统 SHALL support an explicit `plan.xml` attractor check hook that validates a track, phase, or task against a selected attractor profile.

case.given: A `plan.xml` contains an `<attractor-check profile="..." when="..." status="..." />` node under the track, a phase, or a task.
case.when: The execution workflow reaches the hook's guarded scope.
case.then: The system SHALL run attractor alignment validation for that scope using the selected profile.

case.given: An `<attractor-check>` node has `when="before"`, `when="after"`, or `when="both"`.
case.then: The system SHALL apply the same before, after, and both timing semantics used by `<confirm>`.

case.given: An attractor check starts execution.
case.when: The check is running, passes, finds a fixable gap, or cannot proceed.
case.then: The system SHALL update the hook status using `TODO`, `IN_PROGRESS`, `DONE`, `BLOCKED`, or `CANCELLED` consistently with existing confirmation status semantics.

case.given: A track uses one profile for implementation phases and another profile for archive readiness.
case.then: The system SHALL use the profile configured on that specific hook instead of a global one-size-fits-all attractor set.

requirement.statement: 系统 SHALL support configurable post-check policies so attractor gaps can be repaired immediately, routed through confirmation, or blocked for user input.

case.given: An attractor check contains `<result-policy on-gap="fix-immediately" />`.
case.when: The check returns a gap that the executor can safely repair.
case.then: The system SHALL apply the repair and rerun the attractor check before marking the hook `DONE`.

case.given: An attractor check contains `<result-policy on-gap="confirm-before-fix">` with a nested `<confirm protocol="yield-human-confirm" when="after" status="TODO" />`.
case.then: The system SHALL run the nested confirmation before applying the proposed repair.

case.given: An attractor check contains `<result-policy on-gap="block" />`.
case.then: The system SHALL mark the attractor check `BLOCKED` and wait for user input.

case.given: An attractor check executor completes a validation pass.
case.when: It reports the result to the parent workflow.
case.then: The result SHALL include a structured status of `PASS`, `GAP`, or `BLOCKED` plus the profile name, checked scope, summary, and gap details when present.

requirement.statement: 系统 SHALL integrate attractor check hooks into track creation, implementation, wave execution, gap-loop, and archive workflows.

case.given: A new track has completed proposal, design, and plan drafting.
case.when: The track includes a design-level attractor check hook.
case.then: The system SHALL validate the drafted track artifacts against the selected attractor profile before treating the design as confirmed.

case.given: A phase contains an attractor check with `when="after"`.
case.when: All tasks in the phase are complete.
case.then: The implementation workflow SHALL run the attractor check before moving past the phase.

case.given: A track is ready to archive and an archive-readiness attractor profile includes documentation-related attractors.
case.when: The archive workflow reaches the configured attractor check.
case.then: The system SHALL validate archive and documentation-sync readiness against that profile before completing archive steps.

case.given: A plan scope has no attractor check hook.
case.then: The system SHALL NOT require an implicit attractor check only because attractors exist in the workspace.

requirement.statement: 系统 SHALL support `codument/config/operation-hooks.xml` as a sparse workspace-level XML hook overlay for Codument operations that do not have their own `plan.xml` execution plan.

case.given: `codument/config/operation-hooks.xml` contains a `track` operation entry but no `archive` operation entry.
case.when: The user runs `track` and later runs `archive`.
case.then: The system SHALL apply only the configured `track` hooks.
case.and: The system SHALL run `archive` with its existing default behavior.

case.given: `codument/config/operation-hooks.xml` contains an operation hook with nested `<attractor-check>` and `<confirm>` nodes.
case.when: The operation reaches the configured hook point.
case.then: The system SHALL execute those nodes using the same protocol semantics as plan-level hooks.

case.given: An operation defines stable hook points such as `after-design`, `after-plan`, `before-archive`, or `before-revise`.
case.then: The system SHALL execute the hook at that point.
case.and: The system SHALL report validation errors for unknown points when the operation's point list is known.

case.given: No `codument/config/operation-hooks.xml` file exists.
case.when: A Codument command or skill runs.
case.then: The system SHALL NOT require extra hooks or waits solely because the overlay feature exists.

requirement.statement: 系统 SHALL provide a `revise-track` command or skill for correcting or appending an existing track's artifacts during non-linear Codument work.

case.given: A user is implementing, gap-looping, or preparing to archive an existing track.
case.when: The user invokes `revise-track` with a target track and revision request.
case.then: The system SHALL read the target track's proposal, design, spec deltas, plan, analysis, and decisions context.
case.and: The system SHALL update the minimal set of track-local artifacts needed to capture the revision.

case.given: `codument/config/operation-hooks.xml` configures `operation name="revise-track"` with a `before-revise` hook.
case.then: The system SHALL execute the configured hook before modifying the track.
case.and: If the hook is `BLOCKED`, the system SHALL stop without changing track files.

case.given: A revision requires new context, findings, decisions, spec changes, or plan tasks.
case.then: The system SHALL keep required context inside the target track directory.
case.and: The system SHALL NOT require hidden-directory documents or external notes to understand the revised track.

case.given: `revise-track` completes successfully.
case.when: The command or skill reports its result.
case.then: The system SHALL list changed track files, summarize the revision reason, and recommend whether to continue implement, gap-loop, or archive.

requirement.statement: 系统 SHALL support `codument/config/artifacts.xml` as an XML artifact sync registry for hook-triggered artifact generation and synchronization.

case.given: A workspace defines `codument/config/artifacts.xml`.
case.when: The system loads artifact sync configuration.
case.then: The root node SHALL be `artifact-config` with `version="1"`.
case.and: The root SHALL contain `resources` and `artifacts` sections.
The root SHALL NOT require or define a `pipelines` section.

case.given: No `codument/config/artifacts.xml` file exists.
case.when: A Codument command or skill runs.
case.then: The system SHALL continue the default workflow without artifact sync.

requirement.statement: 系统 SHALL restrict artifact sync resources to explicit workflow, skill, attractor-profile, and agent references.

case.given: `codument/config/artifacts.xml` contains a `resources` section.
case.then: The only allowed child nodes under `resources` SHALL be `workflow`, `skill`, `attractor-profile`, and `agent`.

case.given: A `skill` resource references a file such as `/Users/kongweixian/ai/ai-team/multica/terminal/skills/atm-cli/SKILL.md`.
case.then: The system SHALL treat the skill file as a rule or instruction source.
case.and: The system SHALL NOT treat the skill file itself as the artifact output.

case.given: A `workflow` resource references a file under `codument/workflows/`.
case.when: The artifact sync executor prepares an artifact.
case.then: The system SHALL read that workflow file as project-specific execution guidance.

case.given: A `workflow` or `skill` resource references a file path.
case.when: The system validates artifact sync configuration.
case.then: The system SHALL report a validation error when the referenced file is missing.

case.given: An `attractor-profile` resource names a profile from `codument/config/attractor-profiles.json`.
case.when: The artifact sync executor prepares or validates an artifact.
case.then: The system SHALL resolve and use that attractor profile as artifact quality guidance.

requirement.statement: 系统 SHALL define each artifact with compact attributes plus explicit resource, target, and policy child nodes.

case.given: An `artifact` node appears under `artifacts`.
case.then: The only allowed child nodes SHALL be `uses`, `targets`, and `policy`.

case.given: An artifact needs source information.
case.then: The artifact SHALL express stable source information through attributes such as `source-kind` and `source-scope`.
case.and: The artifact MAY keep legacy single-target attributes for compatibility, but new multi-target configuration SHALL use `targets`.

case.given: An artifact has a `uses` child node.
case.when: The artifact sync executor resolves the artifact.
case.then: Each `use` entry SHALL reference a resource id from the `resources` section.

case.given: An artifact has a `targets` child node.
case.when: The artifact sync executor generates the artifact content.
case.then: The system SHALL support one or more `target` entries under `targets`.
case.and: Each target SHALL define its destination kind, directory path, and output path.
The system SHALL treat multiple targets as one generated artifact distributed to multiple destinations, not as multiple independent artifact generations.

case.given: An artifact has a `policy` child node.
case.when: The artifact sync executor applies the artifact.
case.then: The policy MAY define dry-run, conflict, and provenance behavior.

requirement.statement: 系统 SHALL migrate enabled legacy feature sync targets into explicit artifact sync configuration during workspace upgrade.

case.given: `codument/config/feature.json` has `knowledgeSync.enabled=true` with one or more `targets`.
case.and: `codument/config/artifacts.xml` does not exist.
case.then: The system SHALL create `codument/config/artifacts.xml`.
case.and: The generated docs knowledge artifact SHALL use a `docs` attractor profile that includes `codument/attractors/docs-knowledge.md`.
The generated `attractor-profile` resource SHALL reference that profile by `name` and SHALL NOT depend on direct `attractor` or `ref` attributes.
Each legacy knowledge target SHALL become a `target` under the generated artifact's `targets` node.
The system SHALL clear migrated `knowledgeSync.targets` in `feature.json` after writing them to artifacts.xml.

case.given: `codument/config/artifacts.xml` already exists.
case.then: The system SHALL NOT overwrite the existing artifacts.xml.
case.and: The system SHALL NOT remove legacy targets from feature.json unless it has written an equivalent explicit artifact target.

case.given: `projectMemory.enabled=true`.
case.and: `codument/config/artifacts.xml` does not exist.
case.then: The generated artifacts.xml SHALL include a project memory artifact that uses a `memory` attractor profile containing `codument/attractors/project-memory.md`.

requirement.statement: 系统 SHALL allow `operation-hooks.xml` to trigger artifact synchronization through an `artifact-sync` node that references an artifact id.

case.given: `codument/config/operation-hooks.xml` contains an `artifact-sync` node inside a hook.
case.when: The operation reaches that hook point.
case.then: The system SHALL resolve the referenced artifact from `codument/config/artifacts.xml`.
case.and: The system SHALL execute artifact sync according to the artifact's resources and policy.

case.given: An `artifact-sync` hook references an unknown artifact id.
case.when: The hook is validated or executed.
case.then: The system SHALL report a validation error or `BLOCKED` result.

case.given: An artifact sync executor completes.
case.when: It reports to the parent workflow.
case.then: The result SHALL include artifact id, status, summary, changed outputs, and manifest path when provenance is enabled.

requirement.statement: 系统 SHALL expose artifact synchronization through `codument-artifact-sync` rather than docs-specific sync commands.

case.given: Generated lifecycle skills are built for a supported target.
case.when: The system emits standalone Codument skills.
case.then: The system SHALL include `codument-artifact-sync`.
case.and: The system SHALL NOT include `codument-docs-sync-track`.

case.given: The system generates assistant command wrappers for Claude, CodeFlicker, Eidolon, or OpenCode.
case.when: The user inspects the generated command files.
case.then: The system SHALL include an `artifact-sync` command wrapper pointing at `codument-artifact-sync`.
case.and: The system SHALL remove the old `docs-sync-track` command wrapper.

case.given: A docs class artifact needs content selection and docs/modeling versus docs/impl routing rules.
case.when: The artifact sync executor prepares the artifact.
case.then: The system SHALL read those rules from `codument/attractors/docs-knowledge.md` through an attractor profile.
case.and: The artifact-sync skill SHALL handle artifact selection, resource resolution, targets, policy, and execution.

case.given: `codument/config/operation-hooks.xml` contains an archive hook with `point="before-knowledge-sync"`.
case.then: The system SHALL report the hook point as unknown.
case.and: The system SHALL use artifact-sync terminology such as `before-artifact-sync` instead.

requirement.statement: 系统 SHALL provide a domain modeling registry at `codument/modeling/` as an xnl-vfs working tree backed by an xnl-vcs repository, replacing free-form `docs/modeling` as the modeling source of truth.

case.given: A workspace enables the modeling profile.
case.when: The system materializes the modeling registry.
case.then: `codument/modeling/<plane>/<context>/*.xnl` SHALL be human-readable XNL files on disk.
case.and: Node identity SHALL be stable via XNL namespaced ids or `.node-meta` sidecars.

case.given: The modeling registry exists.
case.when: The system records modeling history and collaboration.
case.then: `codument/modeling/**.xnl` SHALL be versioned by the host project git, not a persisted parallel vcs repo.
case.and: Any xnl-vfs/xnl-vcs artifacts (e.g. `.xnl-vcs/`) used as an ephemeral merge engine SHALL live under `.tmp/` and be gitignored.

case.given: The modeling registry is introduced.
case.then: `docs/impl/` SHALL remain the derived implementation/maintenance knowledge plane, not moved into `codument/`.

requirement.statement: 系统 SHALL define modeling nodes as XNL elements with a cross-domain kind spectrum, DEPA fact-source metadata, and minimal required representations per kind.

case.given: A modeling node close to the modeling kernel.
case.then: Kernel kinds SHALL use bare cross-domain tags: `entity`/`object`, `enum`, `state-machine`, `module`/`capsule`, `component`, `port`, `actor`, `policy`.

case.given: A modeling node close to shell/presentation/interaction.
case.then: Shell kinds SHALL use namespaced domain tags such as `surface:route`, `backend:endpoint`, `cli:command`, `agent:tool`.

case.given: A modeling node of a given kind.
case.then: `entity` SHALL carry `types` + `fact_grade` + `single_writer`; `state-machine` SHALL carry `mermaid`; `module` SHALL carry `depends_on` + a capsule-tree; `component` SHALL carry runtime/input/config/output `types` blocks.
case.and: A `module` capsule-tree SHALL reach file/symbol granularity (the files inside each capsule with their responsibility and the modeling node each realizes), not stop at the contract/logic/support layer names.

case.given: A node embeds TypeScript, mermaid, or pseudocode.
case.then: The content SHALL be an XNL `TextElement` with a marker, requiring no escaping.

case.given: A modeling node needs a globally unique id.
case.then: The id SHALL use a multi-level XNL namespaced word: `#<context>.<name>`, or fully qualified across planes as `#<plane>.<context>.<name>`.

case.given: A modeling node describes testable behavior.
case.then: The node SHALL reference `behavior://…` rather than duplicating BDD cases.

case.given: A modeling node references another node or a behavior.
case.when: The reference is written and resolved.
case.then: The canonical reference syntax SHALL be a VFS URI (`modeling://<plane>/<context>/<name>` or `behavior://…`).
case.and: The resolver SHALL treat any metadata/attribute value matching a known VFS scheme as a reference (scheme self-identifying), without a fixed key whitelist.

requirement.statement: 系统 SHALL express a track's modeling change as target-state nodes and apply it at archive via an ephemeral node-level three-way merge (xnl-vfs as merge engine), with the base anchored on the host git commit, rather than a custom delta node type or a persisted parallel vcs repo.

case.given: A track changes modeling.
case.when: The track is created and implemented.
case.then: The change SHALL be written as target-state nodes under `tracks/<id>/modeling_deltas/<plane>/<context>.xnl` (the merge `theirs` side), git-tracked and reviewable.

case.given: A track modeling change.
case.then: The system SHALL record the current host git commit id of `codument/modeling` as the three-way merge base.

case.given: An archived track with modeling changes.
case.when: The system applies the modeling delta.
case.then: The system SHALL materialize base (from host git), ours (working tree), and theirs (modeling_deltas), and run an ephemeral node-level three-way merge via xnl-vfs `xnlFileHandler.merge`.
case.and: Conflicts (`RENAME_RENAME`, `DELETE_MODIFY`, `BINARY_UNMERGEABLE`) SHALL be resolved via `{ metadataId, choice }` or reported issues-first, never silently overwritten.
The merged result SHALL be written back to the working tree and committed by host git; ephemeral merge artifacts SHALL NOT be persisted.

case.given: A three-way modeling merge produces conflicts.
case.then: By default it SHALL auto-merge only unambiguous cases (disjoint nodes, disjoint sub-parts, pure adds, pure deletes) and report true conflicts (same-field, DELETE_MODIFY, RENAME_RENAME, ADD/ADD same id) issues-first, pausing rather than silently choosing a side.
case.and: Per-conflict-type policy SHALL be configurable in `codument/config/modeling.xml` `<merge-policy>` with `resolve` of `human|ours|theirs|base`, defaulting to `human`.

requirement.statement: 系统 SHALL provide a `codument modeling lint` check that flags oversized modeling XNL files for same-name-folder fractal split.

case.given: A modeling XNL file exceeds the configured line or node-count threshold.
case.then: The system SHALL flag the file as a fractal-split candidate.

case.given: A flagged file is split.
case.then: The split SHALL use `vfs.rename` so xnl-vcs tracks the move.

requirement.statement: 系统 SHALL gate all modeling behavior behind `codument/config/modeling.xml` (modeled on `attractor-profiles.xml`), disabled by default.

case.given: A workspace without `codument/config/modeling.xml` or with the modeling profile not enabled.
case.when: Track create, implement, archive, or lint runs.
case.then: The system SHALL skip all modeling behavior and leave existing behavior unchanged.

case.given: `codument/config/modeling.xml` enables the modeling profile.
case.when: A track is created, implemented, or archived.
case.then: The system SHALL produce and apply modeling deltas per this spec.

requirement.statement: 系统 SHALL, at archive when modeling is enabled, write the track's design rationale into `docs/impl/` by category after merging modeling deltas.

case.given: An archived track whose design adds implementation knowledge.
case.when: The system writes back to docs/impl.
case.then: Content SHALL be routed by category (overview/howto/rules/reference/troubleshooting) per the impl fractal standard.

requirement.statement: 系统 SHALL NOT retain `knowledgeSync` string residue; modeling enablement is governed only by `codument/config/modeling.xml`.

case.given: The codebase and templates after this change.
case.then: No `knowledgeSync` references SHALL remain except intentional migration notes.

requirement.statement: 系统 SHALL provide an explicit `codument modeling validate` command that checks every modeling `.xnl` file across three layers — XNL syntax, node-schema semantics, and hierarchy/reference consistency — reporting issues author-friendly (file + line/position + reason) instead of throwing, gated behind `config/modeling.xml` (skipped when modeling is disabled).

case.given: A modeling `.xnl` file with an XNL syntax error (e.g. mismatched text marker, unclosed block).
case.then: The system SHALL parse via xnl-core `parseXnl(.., {textBlockStyle:true})` and report `{file, line/position, reason}`, rather than letting an uncaught `XnlParseError` propagate.
case.and: A syntactically valid file SHALL pass this layer with no finding.

case.given: A modeling node missing a minimal-required representation (e.g. `entity` without `types`/`fact_grade`/`single_writer`, or an unknown bare kind).
case.then: The system SHALL reuse `validateModelingNode` (kind spectrum, minimal representations, `fact_grade` enum, namespaced id) and surface each violation as a finding.

case.given: A node whose id namespace does not match its file path `<plane>/<context>` (e.g. `#inventory.stock` inside `domain/orders/index.xnl`).
case.then: The system SHALL flag a hierarchy violation: the id's context segment MUST equal the path context, and if the id carries a plane prefix it MUST equal the path plane.

case.given: The modeling registry root and a file under some plane.
case.then: The system SHALL require a `domain` plane to exist and accept open derived planes, flagging an unknown plane per `config/modeling.xml` policy (default: warning).

case.given: A node with a `modeling://` reference (`single_writer`/`depends_on`/`derived_from`/`uses`) pointing to a node absent from the registry index.
case.when: validate runs over the full registry.
case.then: The system SHALL resolve `modeling://` references (scheme self-identifying) against the registry index and report dangling references.
case.and: `behavior://` references SHALL be syntax-checked but their existence MAY be left unverified (no hard dependency on the behaviors registry).

case.given: Two nodes sharing the same id across files.
case.then: The system SHALL report the duplicate id with both file locations (as a finding, not an uncaught throw).

case.given: A track's `modeling_deltas/<plane>/<context>.xnl` target-state file.
case.then: The same syntax + schema + hierarchy rules SHALL apply, with the id namespace aligned to the delta file's `<plane>/<context>`.

case.given: `config/modeling.xml` with modeling disabled (default).
case.then: The system SHALL skip and state modeling is disabled, consistent with `lint`/`track`/`archive` gating.

case.given: One or more findings across layers.
case.then: The system SHALL print findings grouped by file with a non-zero summary count (issues-first), and a clean run SHALL report success.

requirement.statement: 系统 SHALL vendor the xnl-core for-AI format guide into codument std as the authoritative XNL syntax reference for authoring modeling nodes, because the published npm package ships only `dist/` (its `doc/ai-guide/` is not packaged).

case.given: An AI author generating modeling XNL needs syntax rules (markers, zero-escape, EBNF, common errors).
case.then: codument SHALL provide `std/spec/xnl-format.md` vendored from `xnl-core` `doc/ai-guide/XnlDataFormatForAi.md`, with a provenance note (source + version).

case.given: The modeling specs (`modeling-registry.md` / `modeling-node-schema.md` / `modeling-delta.md`).
case.then: They SHALL reference `std/spec/xnl-format.md` as the authoritative syntax source instead of re-deriving syntax inline.

requirement.statement: 系统 SHALL guide and validate the XNL *form* of modeling nodes so that LLM authors produce spec-conformant nodes — component IO blocks as bare tags, shell-kind nodes as plain element tags plus a `kind` attribute — while the validate engine accepts the common role-tagged IO variant for compatibility. Derived from E2E dogfood where a real model (codex gpt-5.5) wrote conceptually-correct modeling but tripped on these two XNL-form ambiguities across 3/3 and 1/3 topics.

case.given: A modeling `component` node needing runtime/input/config/output blocks.
case.when: An author writes it per spec.
case.then: The canonical form SHALL be bare tags `<runtime>` / `<input>` / `<config>` / `<output>`, and `modeling-node-schema.md` + `xnl-format.md` SHALL state this explicitly with Good/Bad examples.

case.given: A `component` whose IO blocks are written as `<types role="runtime">` (and input/config/output) instead of bare tags.
case.then: The schema layer SHALL accept a role-tagged block as satisfying the corresponding runtime/input/config/output requirement (compatibility), without raising the "requires a <slot> block" error.
case.and: Bare tags remain the canonical, spec-recommended form; role-tagged is accepted-but-discouraged.

case.given: A shell-kind modeling node (e.g. a backend endpoint or a surface route).
case.when: An author writes its XNL element.
case.then: The element tag SHALL be a plain word (e.g. `<endpoint>`, `<route>`) carrying the namespaced kind in the `kind` attribute (`kind="backend:endpoint"`); the element tag name MUST NOT contain a colon (XNL element tags cannot).
case.and: `modeling-node-schema.md` + `xnl-format.md` SHALL show Good (`<endpoint kind="backend:endpoint">`) vs Bad (`<backend:endpoint …>` → XNL syntax error) examples.

case.given: A track-creation or implement step that generates/edits `modeling_deltas` while modeling is enabled.
case.then: The workflow SHALL run `codument modeling validate --deltas <track>` and surface + repair findings before proceeding.
case.and: This step SHALL be gated on `config/modeling.xml` (skipped when modeling is disabled), consistent with other modeling behavior.

suite.name: Descriptive content in Chinese, identifiers in English

case.given: An author writes a modeling node's descriptive content.
case.then: Descriptive blocks (`desc` / `fact-source` / `not-owned-here` / `dependency-rule` / `invariants`), code comments inside `types` and IO blocks, `pseudo` natural-language steps, and `mermaid` node/transition labels SHALL be written in Chinese.
case.and: Code identifiers — TypeScript interface/type/field names, `enum` members and values, `kind`, `fact_grade`, metadata keys, `#id` namespaces, VFS schemes, and mermaid state names that mirror enum values — SHALL remain in English, so generated TypeScript stays compilable and machine contracts (schema/refs) stay consistent. See std/spec/modeling-node-schema.md §9.

requirement.statement: 系统 SHALL keep `codument/std/sop/` for cross-operation methodology only, with no file that duplicates a single operation's flow already owned by `codument/std/operations/`. Operation-specific procedure SHALL live in the operation prompt; sop SHALL hold shared methodology (questioning/tdd/validation/wave-exec/workflow).

case.given: The std prompt tree.
case.when: An operation already has a complete prompt in `std/operations/<op>.md`.
case.then: There SHALL NOT be a same-named `std/sop/<op>.md` re-stating that operation's flow; archive/artifact-sync/gap-loop SHALL be removed from sop and consolidated into their operations file.

case.given: `sop/artifact-sync.md` carries unique docs-routing guidance not in `operations/artifact-sync.md`.
case.then: Its unique content (docs routing / knowledge-tiers judgement / folder-manifest backfill) SHALL be merged into `operations/artifact-sync.md` first, losing nothing.

case.given: Files reference `sop/{archive,artifact-sync,gap-loop}.md`.
case.then: All references (operations/spec/memory/attractors/skill shells, src/templates + dogfood) SHALL be redirected to the operations file, and `manifest.ts` regenerated; no dangling `sop/{archive,artifact-sync,gap-loop}.md` reference remains.

requirement.statement: 系统 SHALL make the gap-loop first-round verification round a configurable, default-off option (global default overridable per-scope), asked at track creation; and SHALL make every re-check round lightweight/incremental — all to cut fresh-spawn cost without losing the FIX-must-recheck guarantee.

suite.name: Verification round as a config switch

case.given: The global gap-loop config and a scope with no per-scope override.
case.when: A first round returns `NO_GAP` with no history.
case.then: The first-round-suspicion verification round SHALL default to OFF — the parent closes out without an extra round — governed by a global gap-loop config switch (default off).

case.given: A `<cdt:GapLoop>` hook node carrying `verify-round="true|false"`.
case.when: The parent decides whether to run the first-round verification round.
case.then: The node attribute SHALL override the global default for that scope: `true` runs the verification round, `false` skips it (first-round `NO_GAP` closes out).

case.given: Track creation's same-round confirmation (commit mode + validation mode).
case.then: The system SHALL also ask whether to enable the gap-loop verification round, and write the chosen `verify-round` onto the GapLoop hook nodes; later-added phases SHALL follow the same setting.

case.given: verify-round is ON and the parent re-spawns the first-round verification round.
case.then: It SHALL only re-confirm the prior round's gap-report conclusion plus the current uncommitted diff, not re-derive the full target comparison; a lower reasoning effort MAY be used.

case.given: A prior round returned `FIX_APPLIED`.
case.when: The parent re-spawns the mandatory re-check (ALWAYS required, independent of `verify-round`).
case.then: That round SHALL focus on the FIX's changed scope (incremental), not re-review the whole scope from scratch.

requirement.statement: 系统 SHALL name track planning/implement operation prompts and their skill shells consistently in a `codument-plan-<noun>` / `codument-impl-track` family, with skill name = operation base name; high-traffic renamed names keep alias shells, low-traffic ones are dropped.

case.given: The track planning/implement skills and their operation files.
case.then: `codument-implement`→`codument-impl-track`, `codument-track`→`codument-plan-track`, `codument-plan-schedule`→`codument-plan-track-wave`; each skill shell SHALL `@`-reference an operation file of the same base name (`impl-track.md` / `plan-track.md` / `plan-track-wave.md`). Future `codument-plan-mission` (default-DAG) follows the same `codument-plan-<noun>` style.

case.given: Renamed skills are invoked by an old name.
case.then: `codument-implement` and `codument-track` SHALL remain as alias shells routing to the new operation (back-compat); `codument-plan-schedule` SHALL be dropped with no alias.

case.given: References to old skill/operation names.
case.then: All references (operations cross-refs, AGENTS.md, skills/README, src/cli init, std docs; src+dogfood) SHALL point to new names; `codument-plan-schedule` SHALL have zero residual references; `manifest.ts` regenerated to match disk.

requirement.statement: 系统 SHALL manage missions as first-class long-running work items under `codument/missions/{pending,active,archived}/`, not directly under `codument/missions/<mission-id>/`.

case.given: 用户使用 `codument-plan-mission` 创建 mission
case.then: 系统 SHALL create `codument/missions/pending/<mission-id>/`
case.and: 系统 SHALL write `mission.xml`, `proposal.md`, and `design.md` in that directory

case.given: 用户开始执行一个 pending mission
case.then: 系统 SHALL move or require the mission under `codument/missions/active/<mission-id>/`
case.and: 后续执行 SHALL treat `active/<mission-id>/mission.xml` as the state source

case.given: 一个 mission 已完成、取消、废弃或被替代
case.then: 系统 SHALL move it to `codument/missions/archived/YYYY-MM-DD-<mission-id>/`

requirement.statement: 系统 SHALL use `mission.xml`, `proposal.md`, and `design.md` as the standard mission artifacts, and SHALL NOT require `roadmap.md` for new missions.

case.given: 系统创建一个新 mission
case.then: 系统 SHALL NOT create `roadmap.md` as a required artifact
case.and: 路线目标、非目标、成功判据 SHALL be written to `proposal.md`
控制论 actor 模型、DEPA 边界、重规划规则 SHALL be written to `design.md`
阶段、节点、依赖、状态、候选 track SHALL be written to `mission.xml`

case.given: 一个 mission contains `analysis/` and `reports/` directories
case.when: mission execution records findings or run reports
case.then: 这些目录 SHALL be treated as execution-time external memory and default to not being committed to git
case.and: 稳定知识 SHALL still be promoted to docs, behaviors, decisions, or memory according to knowledge tiers

requirement.statement: 系统 SHALL define `mission.xml` as a Track-like XML state source with a `<Mission>` root, default DAG execution, and explicit support for controlled replanning.

case.given: 一个 mission has a `mission.xml` file
case.when: the file is authored or validated
case.then: the root SHALL be `<Mission id="..." version="1" xmlns:cdt="urn:codument:v1">`
case.and: the file SHALL use Track-like `Metadata`, `Ports`, `TaskSpace`, `Schedule`, and `Hooks` sections

case.given: 一个 mission TaskSpace contains top-level mission nodes
case.then: the top-level mission TaskSpace SHALL default to DAG execution
case.and: dependencies SHALL be represented with `Schedule/Dag/Node/After` using the same direct-child dependency rule as track.xml

case.given: an active mission needs nodes or dependencies changed during execution
case.then: 系统 SHALL update `mission.xml` and increment mission revision metadata
case.and: 系统 SHALL write a report explaining the evidence or human decision behind the replan

requirement.statement: 系统 SHALL model mission execution as a cybernetic DEPA actor loop over a DAG-shaped desired state.

case.given: mission execution prompt describes roles
case.when: the prompt explains how execution proceeds
case.then: 系统 SHALL name and use `MissionPlanner`, `MissionObserver`, `MissionReconciler`, and `MissionApplier` actor concepts
case.and: `MissionPlanner` SHALL produce or revise desired mission graph
`MissionObserver` SHALL observe actual state without mutating it
`MissionReconciler` SHALL compare desired and actual state and decide the next convergence action
`MissionApplier` SHALL be the write actor for bounded convergence actions

case.given: a mission execution turn resumes after interruption
case.then: 系统 SHALL read current mission.xml, track states, archive state, reports, and relevant evidence instead of relying on chat history

case.given: mission execution detects a needed convergence action
case.then: 系统 SHALL perform one bounded action per turn or per explicit execution step
case.and: 系统 SHALL avoid silently running unbounded multi-track automation without feedback

requirement.statement: 系统 SHALL provide `codument-plan-mission`, `codument-impl-mission`, and `codument-archive-mission` operation prompts and skill shells that reuse track operation experience while preserving mission-specific replanning semantics.

case.given: 用户使用 `codument-plan-mission`
case.when: the operation prompt describes output shape
case.then: the prompt SHALL include examples for `mission.xml`, `proposal.md`, and `design.md`

case.given: an active mission is being executed
case.when: new evidence invalidates the current mission DAG or a human changes the goal
case.then: `codument-impl-mission` SHALL allow controlled replanning: adding, deleting, modifying nodes or dependencies
case.and: the operation SHALL require evidence or human decision and write a report

case.given: a mission is completed, cancelled, abandoned, or superseded
case.then: the operation SHALL move the mission into `archived/YYYY-MM-DD-<mission-id>/`
case.and: the operation SHALL promote durable decisions or memory candidates when configured, following archive-track experience

requirement.statement: 系统 SHALL maintain flow notation as a reusable standard spec under `codument/std/spec/flow-notation.md`, and operation prompt guidance SHALL reference that spec instead of duplicating the full notation.

case.given: Codument templates are deployed
case.then: `codument/std/spec/flow-notation.md` SHALL exist

case.given: `codument/std/operations/_operation-spec.md` exists
case.when: an operation prompt author reads it
case.then: the file SHALL point to `codument/std/spec/flow-notation.md` as the authoritative flow notation reference
